title: Tencent says WeChat Xiaowei reaches 30M daily users in expanded test
summary: Tencent’s third-quarter 2026 earnings report says WeChat’s Xiaowei AI assistant has expanded testing to 30 million daily active users and is being gradually integrated into chat, Moments, official accounts, and video accounts. Xiaowei uses a custom WeLM model tuned for cost efficiency, and Tencent claims its inference costs are low and continuing to decline. Tencent also says some inference tasks are expected to run on users’ devices in the future. Those figures and plans are Tencent’s own and were not independently verified in the source.
